Guitar Routine — 2026-05-03

Drop D  ·  ~55 min  ·  String skipping · Palm muting · New song exposure

Warm-Up — 10 min

Chromatic spider runs across all 6 strings. Start at 60 BPM 16th notes, push to 80. Even, light pick attack throughout.

Then: open string arpeggios in Drop D — D major, D minor, D sus2. Let ring. This settles the picking hand before real work.

Section 1 — String Skipping, Clean Tone — 15 min

Better Lovers — Lie Between the Lines, Clean Intro
Isolate every string-skip moment: open low D jumping to B or e string. Slow → 60 BPM → 75 → 99. Wrist lifts slightly after low D hit to clear the G string.

Work 2-bar chunks. 4 clean passes before moving on. Don't let the G string ring on any skip.

Section 2 — Palm Muting Consistency — 15 min

Better Lovers — Lie Between the Lines, Section B (♩=135)
Heavy palm mute on open D. Every hit should sound identical — muted, tight, no variation. Start at 100 BPM, build to 120 then 135. If the mute lifts under speed, slow back down.

Palm sits just behind the bridge saddles. Any further back = too muddy. Focus on right hand consistency, not left hand.

Section 3 — New Song Exposure — 10 min

Better Lovers — Your Misplaced Self, opening (p.20)
First page of the next song in the set. Don't aim for clean — just read through slowly and get familiar with the structure. This is sightreading/exploration, not drilling.

No tempo target. Just read the page, find the patterns, note anything that looks tricky for next session.

Cool-Down — 5 min

Free playing in Drop D. No structure, no goal. Let the hands relax.
